items.title: Luis Conte interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 24, 2025
items.q: it was with Camilo Azuquita... And I was the conga player in the band.

ctx.x: Did you have a similar memorable experience with your first studio date? I mean you described your first paying gig really well. And do you recall the first time someone said we want you to record? You go, “Ooh, what’s that?”

Well my very first, first, first, first recording was with a Cuban Latin band, a salsa band you call now, it was with Camilo Azuquita he was a singer from Panama, of Cuban descent, that moved to L.A. and it was actually my first cool salsa gig in L.A. way, way, way back. And he wanted to record a 45, back in those days there were 45s, two songs. And I was the conga player in the band. And I went to the studio, I’d never been in a studio, I’d never seen this. And I realized that I play the congas and we needed…
